## Hinge · Which path is traced? {#fv8-hinge .fv-lesson .curve-lesson}

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="2" class="hinge numeric-choices"><div class="hinge-question"><p>A curve has vector equation</p><div class="curve-equation"><span data-math="\underset{\sim}{r}(t)=(2-t)\underset{\sim}{i}+t^2\underset{\sim}{j},\qquad t\ge0."></span></div><p>Which describes exactly the path traced?</p></div><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="y=(2-x)^2,\quad x\in\mathbb R"></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="y=(2-x)^2,\quad x\le2"></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="y=(2-x)^2,\quad x\ge2"></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="y=(2-x)^2,\quad 0\le x\le2"></span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div><div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>2.</strong> <span data-math="t=2-x\ge0\quad\Rightarrow\quad x\le2."></span> The parameter restriction selects part of the parabola.</div></div>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Additional diagnostic question</div>

::: {.notes}
Correct option 2: equate components x=2−t,y=t²; eliminate t to get y=(2−x)². Since t=2−x≥0, x≤2. Distractor 1 drops the restriction; 3 reverses the inequality; 4 assumes nonnegative t implies nonnegative x. Ready: proceed to Example 3.33. Divided: rewrite t=2−x≥0 and revote. Needs further explanation: substitute t=0,1,3 to give x=2,1,−1, then compare choices. Everyone responds simultaneously with 1–4 fingers. Default 60 seconds, adjustable duration, Start/Pause/Resume, Reset and deliberate answer reveal. Timer expiry alone must not reveal the answer.
:::
